command.addComment: TeX Review: Add comment to selection
config.markerSide: Comment gutter in the review editor: left, right, or hidden.
config.pdfPath: Workspace-relative PDF path. Leave blank for automatic detection. Use the PDF beside its SyncTeX file.
editor.name: TeX Review Studio
config.engine: TeX engine used for builds in the review editor.
config.includePdfComments: Export PDF comment annotations after building. The original PDF is preserved.
config.pdfSync: Source-to-PDF synchronization. Clicking the PDF to navigate to source works in both modes.
config.pdfSync.manual: Move the PDF only when the Sync PDF button is pressed.
config.pdfSync.automatic: Automatically follow the source cursor in the PDF.
config.buildMode: Build mode. The first build and comment-PDF exports always use a full build.
config.buildMode.preview: Run TeX once using existing auxiliary files for a faster preview. References may need a full build.
config.buildMode.full: Run latexmk until references and bibliography are up to date.
